fairness.gpu_preflight_statistic: median of seven one-second nvidia-smi utilization samples
fairness.timing_scope: synchronized eager forward/autograd wall-clock, not a pure GEMM-kernel timer

precision_scope.sura: f32 input/weight/output/gradient storage with f32, f16, or bf16 matmul compute
precision_scope.pytorch: native dtype input/weight/output/gradient storage for each dtype
precision_scope.sura_float32_math_policy: cublasSgemm_v2 with a cuBLAS handle in its default math mode; NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE=0 is applied by the benchmark driver, but this is not an instruction-level IEEE-mode proof
precision_scope.sura_policy_caveat: cuBLAS default math mode plus NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE=0; not an instruction-level IEEE-mode proof
precision_scope.cublas_fast_counter_meaning: successful cuBLAS FAST compute request; Tensor-Core-eligible, not proof of executed HMMA instructions

sura.device_identity_note: current Sura CUDA API exposes index/name/compute capability but not UUID or PCI bus id
sura.float32_math_policy: cublasSgemm_v2 with a cuBLAS handle in its default math mode; NVIDIA_TF32_OVERRIDE=0 is applied by the benchmark driver, but this is not an instruction-level IEEE-mode proof
sura.timing_scope: synchronized eager forward/autograd wall-clock; includes dispatch, allocation, graph work, and ending synchronization; not a pure GEMM-kernel timer

pytorch.timing_scope: synchronized eager forward/autograd wall-clock; includes Python/PyTorch dispatch, allocation, graph work, and ending synchronization; not a pure GEMM-kernel timer
